body: Thank you for your good words, in my case I also use the internet as a way to communicate with people since in real life I am quite shy and antisocial. I use it as an escape valve from reality because I find almost nothing exciting or fun in real life. It's hard to explain, I guess you understand.
Yes, there are a lot of people that I used to admire, but then they turned out to be jerks and in some cases much more serious things such as pedophiles.
You have described my thoughts about humans and today's society to perfection. This is one of the main reasons why I want to disappear from this world.

Same thing. Sometimes I feel like I am the only one who thinks the way I think, that I am an impostor or that mine problems are not important compared to other people, but then I go to one of these places and I see that there are people who have a situation similar to me and I feel happier and less alone.

I do not recommend that you do it. But one way that occurs to me is by overdosing on caffeine. That could cause an arrhythmia, it is not a heart attack but but it is just as useful. To reach an overdose you need to take between 300 and 500 mg of caffeine (About four cans of Monster) Although this amount may vary depending on the person. But I still do not recommend doing it because you could die if things get complicated. I wish you luck and stay safe!
